name: Rot Blossom
summary: Rot Blossoms grow among Duskwood's desecrated graves, fed by blighted soil and undead remains. Their foul alchemical properties make them sought after.

sections.title: Flora of the Crypts
sections.body: In Duskwood, Rot Blossoms grow in the defiled earth of graveyards such as the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. Local rumors say the blooms can take root inside the cracked skulls of Skeletal Horrors and Skeletal Fiends stalking the barrows. For people in Darkshire, gathering them is grim and dangerous. Disturbing the soil means facing the unrested dead.

sections.title: A Gruesome Ingredient
sections.body: Rot Blossoms provide an ingredient for local brews. Their dark essences are needed to make Zombie Juice, a foul draft tied to Duskwood's efforts to survive. Those sent to gather the flowers often aid the Night Watch as they cut down restless skeletons wandering the haunted graves.

faq.q: Where can Rot Blossoms be found?
faq.answer: Rot Blossoms grow in Duskwood's corrupted burial grounds, particularly in the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. They are also known to sprout from the remains of undead skeletal fiends.

faq.q: What are Rot Blossoms used for?
faq.answer: Local brewers and alchemists use Rot Blossoms to make Zombie Juice, a potent and foul mixture.

faq.q: Why do these blossoms grow in skeletons?
faq.answer: Duskwood's lingering dark magic infects the earth and the restless dead. Rot Blossoms feed on necrotic corruption and decay, and can sprout inside the skulls and ribcages of roaming skeletons.

faq.q: How does gathering Rot Blossoms help Darkshire?
faq.answer: Gathering Rot Blossoms in places such as the Tranquil Gardens means cutting down the Skeletal Horrors and Fiends that plague the grounds. That gives needed relief to Althea Ebonlocke and the beleaguered Night Watch.

angles.text: Rot Blossoms are foul plants fed by necrotic rot and graveyard soil, unlike herbs nurtured by light and rain. They offer a grim study in corrupted flora.
Gathering these morbid blooms in cursed soil also helps the Night Watch keep ravenous skeletons from Darkshire's borders.
